Σωστές απαντήσεις

GUSTAVO
“Hello everyone! My name is Gustavo. I am 10 years old and I am from Brazil. I live in Rio de Janeiro. Like many Brazilians, I love playing football. My favourite player is Neymar. I hope to be a great football player one day!”
YUKI
“Hello everyone! My name is Yuki. I am 10 years old and I am from Japan. I live in Tokyo. In my free time, I like getting dressed in traditional Japanese clothes. I love their beautiful colours and patterns. I want to be a teacher one day.”
FRITZ
“Hello everyone! My name is Fritz. I am 11 years old and I am from Germany. I live in Berlin. I love eating sausages. I do not drink beer because I am still a child! In my free time, I love making models of houses. I want to be an architect one day.”
CAMILLE
“Hello everyone! My name is Camille. I am 10 years old and I am from France. I live in Paris. In my free time, I love painting flowers, people and beautiful places. I often visit Montmartre Hill to see the street painters. I want to be a painter one day.”
